predictors.sta: per-corner case-analyzed extracted STA: T_fail = T_clk - slack; f = 1e3/T_fail MHz (docs/prediction-model.md)
predictors.ro_gen: nominal STA ladder scaled by ro_gen count ratio N(corner)/N(nom) at can_sel=3, win0
predictors.ro_mat: nominal STA ladder scaled by ro_mat count ratio N(corner)/N(nom) at can_sel=3, win0

calibration.note: post-silicon run substitutes measured k_x per predictor and re-emits; nothing else changes

notes: Frame = 19 clk cycles (frame_cnt 0..18); one timed DUT operation per frame.
Canary counters are 16-bit and saturate at 65535 with a sat flag; win0 = 256 clk cycles.

The sdfsim.csv RO cross-check row (FORCE_CAN off) is INVALID for model purposes: RO loop cells carry hard 0.000 SDF delays because src/pnr.sdc disables RO timing arcs (docs/ro-sdf-crosscheck-diagnosis.md); its gen_cnt/mat_cnt are excluded.
The SDF boundary is IOPATH-only annotated (no wire interconnect): the sim boundary is optimistic; positive err_sta_minus_mid_ns = STA more conservative than sim.

invalid_rows.reason: FORCE_CAN off: RO cells carry hard 0.000 SDF delays; counts are race artifacts, excluded (docs/ro-sdf-crosscheck-diagnosis.md)
